constraints.ocl:
context User
inv: (self.createdAt <> '') and (self.posts->forAll(v | v.isPublic = true))

context User
inv: (self.email <> '') and (self.notifications->forAll(v | v.isSeen = false))

context User
inv: (self.username <> '') and (self.posts->forAll(v | v.isPublic <> false))

context Post
inv: (self.isPublic = true) and (self.reactions->forAll(v | v.createdAt <> ''))

context Conversation
inv: self.participants->size() >= 1 and self.participants->size() <= 3

context Conversation
inv: self.messages->size() >= 3 and self.messages->size() <= 3

context Tag
inv: self.posts->size() >= 1 and self.posts->size() <= 1

context Conversation
inv: self.participants->size() >= 2 and self.participants->size() <= 2

context Post
inv: self.comments->size() >= 1 and self.comments->size() <= 3

context Conversation
inv: self.messages->exists(x | x.isRead = true)

context User
inv: self.posts->exists(x | x.isPublic = true)

context User
inv: (self.posts->one(x | x.isPublic = true)) and (self.email.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')

context FriendRequest
inv: (self.fromUser.profile.fullName <> '') and (self.createdAt.size() >= 2 implies self.createdAt.substring(1, 2) = 'AB')

context User
inv: (self.profile <> null) and (self.username.size() >= 2 implies self.username.substring(1, 2) = 'AB')

context Reaction
inv: ((self.post.isPublic) and (self.type <> null)) and (self.createdAt <> '' and self.createdAt.size() > 0)

context Reaction
inv: ((self.post.author = self.user) and (self.post.oclIsTypeOf(Post))) and (self.user.oclIsTypeOf(User))

context Comment
inv: (self.post.isPublic) and (self.createdAt.size() >= 8 implies self.createdAt.substring(1, 8) = 'AB')

context Comment
inv: (self.post.author.email <> '') and (self.createdAt <> '' and self.createdAt.size() > 0)

context Group
inv: self.memberships->size() >= 2 and self.memberships->size() <= 2

context Conversation
inv: self.messages->forAll(x | x.isRead <> false)

context Post
inv: (self.media->any(x | x.mediaType <> '') <> null) and (self.createdAt.size() >= 2 implies self.createdAt.substring(1, 2) = 'AB')

context User
inv: (self.email <> '') and (self.posts->forAll(v | v.isPublic = true))

context User
inv: (self.username <> '') and (self.notifications->forAll(v | v.isSeen <> true))

context Post
inv: (self.isPublic <> false) and (self.reactions->forAll(v | v.createdAt <> ''))
